recoverability.rationale: Revise design/test only; no schema, persisted state or deployed runtime changed.

statusQuoRisk.rationale: Implementation readiness remains blocked; HOLD preserves the production boundary.

materialBoundaries.invariant: No new submission lock after head.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A cutoff misses S; B inserts S; A holds H; C locks S waiting H; A register waits S.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Base intake lines517-525 and oracle lines134-136 re-read without another submission lock.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Runtime has no direct head/authz UPDATE or submission INSERT.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Caller directly mutates authoritative columns or assumes owner.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Design lines67,82,86-110; exact-head local oracle denies DML, role assumption and PUBLIC/reader execution.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Current coherent authorization remains valid through commit.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Conflicting membership inserted while only existing auth rows are locked.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Design line80 requires all auth writers to serialize on head; formal provisioning denied without that contract.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Revocation and admission commit have a durable atomic ordering.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Registry authority revoked after a callback check but before SQL commit.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Design line142 explicitly withholds admission INSERT/EXECUTE pending durable locking or fencing.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Unknown commit is not success; only the old-site chain publishes schema.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: ACK loss triggers blind replay or a new publisher bulk-upgrades the prefix.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Design lines144,148-150 retain UNKNOWN_STOP, exact successor/readback and sole publisher.
